title: How to Stay Ahead of Cutting Edge Game Technology
description: Over the last two decades, videogame technology has evolved dramatically, from tightly constrained hardware and bespoke engines to globally connected platforms, shared toolsets and rapid innovation. In this panel, technology leaders from Sumo Digital will look back at how the industry reached this point, examine the realities studios face today, and discuss what the next wave of change could mean for teams, pipelines and leadership.
session_takeaway: A clearer understanding of how past technology decisions continue to influence modern game development.
Practical insight into the trends currently shaping production and studio operations.
A more grounded perspective on emerging technologies and how to approach them realistically.
